title: Trump Gutted the Kennedy Center. A Tour Guide Wants You to See It Anyway.
summary: In a dogged demonstration of love for a Washington institution, Sandy Weiswasser is among a few dozen volunteers still showing dwindling visitors a hollowed-out building.
